title: 第17章 暗界魔域第18章 界河
slug: 圣殇天狱第1013章力战古神
content_zh:
灰暗的天空，
一轮脸盆的大白日在缓慢移动，
虚空中飘洒着一缕缕灰黑雾气，形成厚厚的乌云，
让原本就灰暗的世界更加灰黑，
一年四季极度阴冷，
阴暗滋生罪恶，邪魔，
万物生灵都偏灰黑，灰白。
他们天性阴邪，凶狠，吞噬，残暴，歹毒。
在很久以前，
这里是没有太阳，而且阳光也照射不到的；暗界！
不知道那轮白日是何时怎么出现的，
这里便是；魔域！
魔域在大宇宙暗处无边无际，
甚至生命星域黑暗的地方都能产生；魔！
超级神魔大战，
魔域同样遭受了致命的打击，
但他们的繁育和生存适应能力更强，
战力值提升更快。
魔域魔族同样分了万族，
他们也有不同的文明和信仰。

一部分魔族向往光明世界，
他们在卧薪尝胆，养精蓄锐，
等待时机彻底毁灭，奴隶光明世界，
凭什么低级无能的弱鸡就该生存在暗黑世界！
神魔大战后，
自从有了那轮白日后，
那些魔物一部分长相向光明世界人类靠拢，
他们有了魔的强悍，人的灵动，
他们叫；人魔族。
因为综合了魔和人的优势天赋，
很快从魔域崛起，
成为魔域超强种族一支，
也是最向往霸占光明世界的一支魔族！
~~~~~

闷雷滚滚，
日月无光，

gray sky,
The broad daylight of the basin moves slowly,
Wisps of gray and black mist floated in the void, forming thick dark clouds.
Make the already dark world even darker,
It is extremely cold all year round,
Darkness breeds sin, evil spirits,
All living things are gray-black and gray-white.
Their nature is sinister, vicious, devouring, cruel, and vicious.
a long time ago,
There is no sun here, and the sunlight cannot reach it; the dark world!
I don’t know when and how that round of day appeared,
This is it; the Demon Realm!
The demonic realm is endless in the darkness of the universe,
Even dark places in the life star field can produce; demons!
Super war between gods and demons,
The Demon Realm also suffered a fatal blow,
But their breeding and survival adaptability are stronger,
Combat value increases faster.
The demons in the Demon Realm are also divided into ten thousand races.
They also have different civilizations and beliefs.
Some demons yearn for a bright world;
They are working hard to recharge their batteries and recharge their batteries.
Waiting for the opportunity to completely destroy, slave the bright world,
Why should low-level and incompetent weaklings live in the dark world!
After the battle between gods and demons,
Ever since that round of daylight,
Some of those monsters look closer to humans in the light world.
They have the strength of demons and the agility of humans,
They are called; the human-demon tribe.
Because of the combination of the superior talents of demons and humans,
Quickly emerged from the demonic realm,
Become a super powerful race in the Demonic Realm,
They are also the demon clan that most longs to occupy the bright world!
